description: Defines the QuicPacketWriter interface and related structures for QUIC packet writing, including batch and pass-through modes, buffer management, and error handling.

classes.name: QuicPacketWriter
classes.description: Interface for writing QUIC packets, supporting batch and pass-through modes, with methods for writing packets, buffer management, and socket status.

classes.name: PerPacketOptions
classes.description: Abstract class representing options for individual packets, including cloning and ECN settings.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Sends a packet with specified buffer, addresses, and options, returning a WriteResult indicating success, blockage, or error.

methods.name: IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the network socket is currently writable.

methods.name: SetWritable
methods.description: Marks the socket as writable after it was previously blocked.

methods.name: MessageTooBigErrorCode
methods.description: Returns an optional error code indicating if the message was too big to send.

methods.name: GetMaxPacketSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum packet size supported for a given peer address.

methods.name: SupportsReleaseTime
methods.description: Indicates if the socket supports release timestamp feature.

methods.name: IsBatchMode
methods.description: Indicates if the writer operates in batch mode.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Provides a buffer location for direct packet serialization in batch mode.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Attempts to send all buffered packets, returning a WriteResult.
